**The schedule data doesn't show which subcontractor is responsible.** The activities carry a code, name, WBS and dates, but no contractor, resource or responsibility field. I can show you *where* the delay came from, but not *whose* it is.

**What the data does show**

Project completion #MS-COMPLETE moved from 23 Mar 2029 to 22 Jun 2029 (+65 days) in this update. #MS-P07 Phase 7 complete moved by the same amount. All of the delay is on the driving path, and almost all of it is in Phase 7, section 2. It comes from durations getting longer, not from progress, logic or constraint changes:

| Activity | Name | Added delay |
|---|---|---|
| #P07-A002-STN-0100 | Excavate platform edge, section 2 | +18 days |
| #P07-A002-OLE-0050 | Test cable troughing, section 2 | +12 days |
| #P07-A002-OLE-0220 | Excavate platform edge, section 2 | +12 days |
| #P07-A002-TEL-0140 | Set out mast foundations, section 2 | +11 days |
| #P07-A002-SIG-0190 | Erect cable troughing, section 2 | +9 days |
| #P05-A005-ENB-0200 | Install points machine, section 5 | +5 days |
| #P06-A009-ENB-0120 | Set out sleepers, section 9 | +2 days |
| #P07-A002-ENB-0060 | Fabricate signal gantry, section 2 | -1 day (recovered) |
| #P07-A002-TRK-0210 | Pour points machine, section 2 | -1 day (recovered) |

The codes contain discipline tags (STN, OLE, TEL, SIG, ENB). #P07-A002-STN-0100 sits under the "Stations" WBS. So the delay is spread across several disciplines, not one. But a discipline isn't a subcontractor, and I wouldn't assume each one maps to a single firm.

**Worth checking:** #P07-A002-STN-0100 went from 2 to 20 days' original duration in this update, with no progress. It now has -59 days of total float. A jump that size is worth confirming with whoever made the change before anyone is held responsible. It could be a re-estimate or a data-entry error.

**To answer your question properly** you'd need a link from these activities to who does the work. That could be resource assignments, an activity code or user-defined field for contractor, or your subcontract package register. If you can tell me how the disciplines map to subcontractors, I can tally the delay by subcontractor. I can also go through the other contributors to see what changed on each.
